about.description: Codebase intelligence for AI and humans: code health scores, auto-generated docs, git analytics, dead code detection, and architectural decisions via MCP.
about.head: 50e667a

name: v0.60.0
body:
## What's Changed
* fix(ingestion): stop one file from hanging or exhausting the parse by @RaghavChamadiya in https://github.com/repowise-dev/repowise/pull/4738
* fix(update): persist updates for a subdirectory index and scope git rows to it by @Marko0519 in https://github.com/repowise-dev/repowise/pull/4195
* feat(plugins): list every plugin registration, load plugin providers, add SeamRegistry.all and PLUGIN_API_VERSION by @RaghavChamadiya in https://github.com/repowise-dev/repowise/pull/4741
* docs(plugins): add a plugin author guide, a hello example plugin and a test that keeps it working by @RaghavChamadiya in https://github.com/repowise-dev/repowise/pull/4742
* docs(readme): lead with the agent savings, a new hero and plain-English benchmarks by @RaghavChamadiya in https://github.com/repowise-dev/repowise/pull/4750
* fix(health): stop flagging flat boolean chains as compound conditions by @RaghavChamadiya in https://github.com/repowise-dev/repowise/pull/4754
* fix(health): skip cancellation catches and documented fallbacks in error_handling, state facts in idiom reasons by @RaghavChamadiya in https://github.com/repowise-dev/repowise/pull/4755
* fix(server): take the update lock in background syncs and never overwrite newer health rows by @RaghavChamadiya in https://github.com/repowise-dev/repowise/pull/4756
* fix(health): stop primitive_obsession on CLI commands, keyword-only and framework-bound parameters, and same-file overrides by @RaghavChamadiya in https://github.com/repowise-dev/repowise/pull/4758
* fix(health): name C++ reference, operator, destructor and macro-prefixed functions by @RaghavChamadiya in https://github.com/repowise-dev/repowise/pull/4766
* fix(health): skip lock_in_loop when the lock belongs to the loop element by @RaghavChamadiya in https://github.com/repowise-dev/repowise/pull/4767
* fix(health): a switch opens one nesting level, its case arms none by @RaghavChamadiya in https://github.com/repowise-dev/repowise/pull/4762
* fix(coverage): drop files whose report lines no longer match the source at ingest by @RaghavChamadiya in https://github.com/repowise-dev/repowise/pull/4761
* fix(health): count Python pathlib-named calls as file IO only on a path receiver by @RaghavChamadiya in https://github.com/repowise-dev/repowise/pull/4764
* fix(health): stop god_class judging one part of a split partial class or a stateless mixin as the whole class by @RaghavChamadiya in https://github.com/repowise-dev/repowise/pull/4759
* fix(health): count TSX style objects and data props as markup, not code by @RaghavChamadiya in https://github.com/repowise-dev/repowise/pull/4760
* fix(health): stop defer_in_loop and list_insert_zero_in_loop firing when a later statement ends the loop by @RaghavChamadiya in https://github.com/repowise-dev/repowise/pull/4768
* fix(health): stop counting abstract, interface and extern methods as function units by @RaghavChamadiya in https://github.com/repowise-dev/repowise/pull/4772
* fix(health): make three performance findings say only what the code shows by @RaghavChamadiya in https://github.com/repowise-dev/repowise/pull/4773
* fix(health): say what held-back findings deduct in get_health, and describe the change-risk score basis by @RaghavChamadiya in https://github.com/repowise-dev/repowise/pull/4776
* fix(code-origin): class parser-generator output as generated and copied single-file libraries as vendored by @RaghavChamadiya in https://github.com/repowise-dev/repowise/pull/4784
* fix(health): stop pairing the shared skeleton of sibling files as duplication by @RaghavChamadiya in https://github.com/repowise-dev/repowise/pull/4788
* fix(health): keep coverage markers off empty files and code that does not ship by @RaghavChamadiya in https://github.com/repowise-dev/repowise/pull/4765
* fix(health): stop sql_select_star on EXISTS and explicit-column sources, skip temp-table DML by @RaghavChamadiya in https://github.com/repowise-dev/repowise/pull/4775
* fix(health): repeated_nesting becomes advisory by @RaghavChamadiya in https://github.com/repowise-dev/repowise/pull/4757
* fix(health): price refactoring and fix gains by rescoring the file, not summing health_impact by @RaghavChamadiya in https://github.com/repowise-dev/repowise/pull/4763
* fix(health): count a match guard once and skip for-each iterables in condition counts by @RaghavChamadiya in https://github.com/repowise-dev/repowise/pull/4783
* fix(health): make the headline split add up and mark advisory rows in the CLI findings table by @RaghavChamadiya in https://github.com/repowise-dev/repowise/pull/4770
* fix(health): treat extern C signatures as fixed and a condition-variable wait guard as unhoistable by @RaghavChamadiya in https://github.com/repowise-dev/repowise/pull/4781
* fix(ingestion): parse C++ classes behind export macros and fields behind thread-safety annotations by @RaghavChamadiya in https://github.com/repowise-dev/repowise/pull/4785
* fix(health): scope finding status updates to the requested repository by @jsolemd in https://github.com/repowise-dev/repowise/pull/4725

* fix(cli): surface broken built-in seam imports in `repowise plugins` by @Asymtode712 in https://github.com/repowise-dev/repowise/pull/4748
* fix(ui): keep the Overview header intact while a job runs by @jgt87 in https://github.com/repowise-dev/repowise/pull/4735
